title: 6 March 1963: Radio: Here We Go
content:
The Beatles appeared five times on the BBC Light Programme’s radio show Here We Go (initially known as Teenager’s Turn – Here We Go). This was the final occasion.

The session took place at the Playhouse Theatre in Manchester, and the producer was Peter Philbeam. The Beatles began rehearsing at 4pm, and between 8pm and 8.45pm recorded ‘I Saw Her Standing There’, ‘Misery’, ‘Do You Want To Know A Secret’, and ‘Please Please Me’.

The show was broadcast from 5pm on Tuesday 12 March 1963. All the songs apart from ‘I Saw Her Standing There’ were included.

The performance of ‘Misery’ from this session was released on 2013’s On Air – Live At The BBC Volume 2.

Page last updated: 22 August 2025
